methods.candidate_workaround: Split syntax compilation and Git-state inspection into separate bounded probes, crediting each only after its own successful result.
methods.failure_signature: A combined syntax-compilation and Git-status wrapper exceeded its 30-second bound without returning a result.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not combine Python compilation and broad Windows Git status in one short wrapper; use separate bounds and outputs.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed wrapper, and leave repository history and external state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for combined_syntax_status_wrapper_timeout

methods.candidate_workaround: Read git status --porcelain=v1 as raw captured output, preserve both status columns, and slice the path only after the fixed prefix.
methods.failure_signature: The first route build stripped the leading porcelain status column and misread an allowed scripts path as beginning with cripts.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never apply whole-output strip operations before parsing fixed-column Git porcelain records.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed wrapper, and leave repository history and external state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for porcelain_leading_column_trim

methods.candidate_workaround: Declare the closeout compatibility test as a route-correction path and permit only the builder's own phase artifacts during an idempotent retry from the unchanged closeout head.
methods.failure_signature: The second route build omitted the deliberately updated closeout compatibility test from its final correction allowlist and stopped before manifest creation.
methods.recurrence_guard: When a route correction changes a historical compatibility assertion, include that exact test in both starting and final path allowlists.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed wrapper, and leave repository history and external state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for route_correction_allowlist_omission

methods.candidate_workaround: Read predecessor route truth from the immutable closeout Git blob rather than from the mutable working tree.
methods.failure_signature: The idempotent retry reread the already-corrected working route and could not find the predecessor exact-title field.
methods.recurrence_guard: Bind every predecessor lifecycle read to its declared immutable commit whenever an additive correction may rerun.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed wrapper, and leave repository history and external state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for mutable_predecessor_route_read

methods.candidate_workaround: Freeze inherited, evidence, and closeout Method Flow paths while explicitly admitting only route-correction-prefixed Method Flow artifacts in the additive correction.
methods.failure_signature: The first correction test gate classified the newly created route-correction Method Flow files as mutations of the frozen closeout Method Flow domain.
methods.recurrence_guard: Define freeze domains by lifecycle ownership, not by a broad top-level directory prefix.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed wrapper, and leave repository history and external state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for route_method_flow_frozen_scope_misclassification

methods.candidate_workaround: Use the repository-native unittest module entrypoints already declared by the phase tests and final validator.
methods.failure_signature: A bounded pre-commit wrapper assumed pytest was installed and stopped with No module named pytest before running any test.
methods.recurrence_guard: Probe runner availability or use the repository-declared unittest entrypoint instead of assuming an optional pytest installation.
methods.rollback: Stop, retain the failed wrapper, and leave repository history and external state unchanged.
methods.title: Bounded recovery for unavailable_pytest_entrypoint
